description: 4 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars are GitHub Actions work: a failing workflow, a new check, a test matrix, a reusable workflow. Near-misses share the CI or GitHub vocabulary and route elsewhere: a red test that is a code bug reproducible outside CI (systematic-debugging), tuning the Copilot assistant (copilot-config), and infrastructure provisioning (terraform). Counterexamples guard the 'pipeline' and 'action' vocabulary in unrelated work.

queries.q: my CI is failing on the setup-node step in the GitHub Actions workflow — fix the YAML
add a test matrix for PHP 8.2 and 8.3 to our workflow file
extract the shared lint steps into a reusable workflow that both repos can call
füge einen GitHub-Actions-Check hinzu, der bei jedem Pull Request die Tests ausführt
this unit test fails locally too — find out why the date parsing is off by one day
queries.note: the red check is a code bug reproducible outside CI, not workflow configuration → systematic-debugging

queries.q: make GitHub Copilot's PR review comments shorter
queries.note: GitHub and pull-request vocabulary, but the ask tunes the Copilot assistant → copilot-config

queries.q: provision the staging ECS cluster and its load balancer as code
queries.note: deployment-adjacent infrastructure, not the workflow that triggers it → terraform

queries.q: design a sales pipeline with stages from lead to closed-won
write the action items from today's meeting into a list
